drafted_from: tool:google-account-list_new_mail's own row in tools/read-and-write-gmail/tool-rows.json (invoke method, url, body_template, input and output schema); Gmail response values worked out from that row for the synthetic input
start_here: Say to your AI: "What mail reached my inbox since history point 482913? Use my Google account connection service_connection:google-account:sam-bakery." It runs tool:google-account-list_new_mail as that account and hands back the Gmail answer.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list: it calls Gmail for one Google account the connection names and answers what Gmail returns.
instructions: 1. Connect a Google account in your Workshop connections and note its handle, like service_connection:google-account:sam-bakery.

2. Say to your AI: "What mail reached my inbox since history point 482913?" and let it call run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:google-account-list_new_mail, and the input {"connection":{"connection_id":"service_connection:google-account:sam-bakery"},"since":"482913"}.
3. Read what comes back: the request goes as GET  the Gmail me-mailbox base (gmail.googleapis.com, v1)/history?startHistoryId=482913&historyTypes=messageAdded&labelId=INBOX&maxResults=100.
4. Read each message id it lists with tool:google-account-read_mail_headers; with no new mail the answer holds only historyId.

worked_examples.ask: What mail reached my inbox since history point 482913?

The call it makes: GET the Gmail me-mailbox base (gmail.googleapis.com, v1)/history?startHistoryId=482913&historyTypes=messageAdded&labelId=INBOX&maxResults=100.
